summary: Backend API testing for iteration 81 - New Client Creation from Unmatched Transactions and Auto-Archive features. All 9 tests passed after fixing a MongoDB duplicate key bug.

minor.issue: IGNORE_KEYWORDS filtering uses substring match which can cause false positives (e.g., 'ost' in 'TEST_PositiveUnmatched'). Consider using word boundary matching.

critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: registration_code: '' was causing E11000 duplicate key error. Fixed by removing registration_code field from new client creation (allows sparse unique index to work correctly).

Note: The import flags (imported, import_needs_review, imported_from_statement) are stored in DB but NOT returned by GET /api/clients/{id} due to Pydantic response_model filtering. They ARE returned by GET /api/clients list endpoint.

details.negative_amount_creates_client: New client created with loan_amount set
details.import_needs_review_flag: Set to True on created client
details.imported_flag: Set to True on created client
details.imported_from_statement_flag: Set to True on created client

positive_unmatched_not_creates_client.details: Positive amounts for non-existent clients go to unmatched_transactions, NOT new_clients_created

details.loan_fully_paid_flag: Set to True in payment response

summary_totals_consistency.details: total_transactions = loans_created + payments_recorded + new_clients_created + ignored + unmatched + errors

bugs_fixed.issue: E11000 duplicate key error on registration_code when creating new clients from bank statement
bugs_fixed.root_cause: registration_code was set to empty string '' which conflicts with unique index when other clients have empty registration_code
bugs_fixed.fix: Removed registration_code field from new client document (allows sparse unique index to work)

seed_data_creation: Created test clients with TEST_ and NEWCLIENT_ prefixes for reconciliation testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: New client creation from unmatched negative transactions is now working. Auto-archive on full payment works. The import flags are stored in DB but only visible via list endpoint (not single client GET due to response_model). The IGNORE_KEYWORDS filtering in bulk_import.py uses substring matching which can cause false positives - consider word boundary matching in future.
